title: Monitoring the Internal Monologue: Probe Trajectories Reveal Reasoning Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2605.18549v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) introduce new opportunities for safety monitoring through their Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, CoT is not always faithful to the model's final output, undermining its reliability as a monitoring tool. To address this, we investigate the hidden representations of LRMs to determine whether future behavior can be predicted from prompt and CoT representations. By evaluating a probe at each generated token, we construct a probe trajectory, the continuous evolution of a concept's probability across the reasoning process. To characterize these temporal dynamics, we extract signal-processing features that capture volatility, trend, and steady-state behavior. We find that trajectory features help precisely where the static probe is weakest, adding 21.7 AUROC points on average, and improving in every such case where that probe falls below 70. translated_abstract: 大型推理模型通过其思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理为安全监控提供了新的机会。然而，CoT 并不总是忠实于模型的最终输出，这削弱了其作为监控工具的可靠性。为解决这一问题，我们研究了大型推理模型的隐藏表示，以确定能否从提示和 CoT 表示中预测其未来行为。通过在生成的每个 token 上评估探针，我们构建了“探针轨迹”，即某个概念的概率在推理过程中的连续演变。为了刻画这些时间动态特征，我们提取了能够捕捉波动性、趋势和稳态行为的信号处理特征。我们发现，轨迹特征恰好在静态探针表现最薄弱的地方发挥作用，平均带来 21.7 个 AUROC 点的提升，并且在静态探针低于 70 的所有情况下均有所改进。我们还提出了两点方法论见解。首先，模板……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出通过在推理过程每个 token 上评估探针来构建“探针轨迹”，并提取波动性、趋势等信号处理特征刻画其时间动态，从而在静态探针表现最薄弱的场景下平均提升 21.7 个 AUROC 点，显著增强对大型推理模型未来行为的预测与安全监控能力。
en_tdlr: By constructing probe trajectories that track concept probabilities across the reasoning process and extracting signal-processing features capturing their temporal dynamics, this work improves prediction of LRM future behavior by 21.7 AUROC points on average precisely where static probes are weakest.
